title: capsicum annuum var. microcarpum
intro: Capsicum annuum var. microcarpum, commonly known as Thai bird's eye chili or small-fruited chili, is a variety of the chili pepper plant. It is a perennial plant belonging to the nightshade family, known for its small, hot fruits that are rich in nutritional value and bioactive compounds. Thai bird's eye chili has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in reducing pain, improving circulation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Thai bird's eye chili include capsaicin, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-hypertension, and anti-cancer properties.
